relevant_files.why: Root config for all modules (no per-module build files); group com.snoworca.naruserve 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT, release=8, animal-sniffer API 21 only on NaruServe-api, servlet-api 3.1.0 compileOnly. Every new module (#1,#8,#9,#16,#17) is added here.
Only includes :NaruServe-api and :NaruServe-servlet; #1 adds new modules and includeBuild('../TinyHttpd').
Empty skeleton (no src). Core public API/SPI lands here (#2-#7, #9 SPI, #10-#14 API).
API contract (18 docs). Each issue resolves its (미확정) items here.
Root project 'tinyhttpd-project'; modules :tinyhttpd-core/webserver/websocket/router/session (+:bench). Gradle 8.14.3 like NaruServe.

group com.snoworca.tinyhttpd, version 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT, java-library + animal-sniffer API 21, no maven-publish plugin, zero external runtime deps (SEC-16 check). core exposes java-test-fixtures (RawConnection, client helpers).
Engine request interface (getMethod/getPath/getRequestURI/getQueryParameter*/getHeader(s)/getCookies/getInputStream/readMultipart/getRemoteAddr/isSecure/attributes) wrapped by NaruServe Request.
Engine response (setStatus/setHeader/addCookie/isCommitted/getOutputStream/sendFile/startEventStream/upgrade/setCloseConnection) wrapped by NaruServe Response.
Already enforces 414 request-line, 431 headers, CL+TE conflict 400, TE in HTTP/1.0 400, non-final chunked 400 -> #8 only wires config.

tinyhttpd_reuse.notes: router/src/main/java/com/snoworca/tinyhttpd/router/Router.java. Has route(method,pattern,h)/mount(prefix). NaruServe spec needs static>param priority, conflict detection at listen(), 405+Allow, auto HEAD/OPTIONS, 501, MethodSet — implement NaruServe's own Router in NaruServe-api (#3); do not depend on tinyhttpd-router from Core (Core must stay engine-free).
core/src/main/java/com/snoworca/tinyhttpd/http/. Adapted only inside NaruServe-tinyhttpd (#8); NaruServe Request/Response state machines (BodyState, NEW->COMMITTED->...) are NaruServe-owned (#4).
Builder.maxRequestBodyBytes (default -1 = unlimited), maxDrainBytes 64KiB. JSON 1 MiB/depth 64 limits are NaruServe-side (#9); map engine exceptions to 413/400.

Request.readMultipart(MultipartLimits) streaming parser with maxTotalBytes/maxParts/maxPartBytes/maxPartHeaderBytes. NaruServe adds memory->disk spooling (memoryThreshold, tempDirectory), UploadFile and temp-file cleanup (#11). Core needs its own multipart parser abstraction behind HttpAdapter for the memory adapter/Servlet.

FileResponses.serve/etag/evaluatePreconditions/parseRange/attachment gives Range 206/416, If-Range, ETag/304. StaticFileHandler has directoryListing/followSymlinksOutsideRoot/untrustedContent. MimeTypes.register is global static (conflicts with per-mount MIME precedence) — NaruServe should keep its own MIME table in Core and use Response.sendFile for zero-copy in the adapter (#12). Core logic (range/etag parsing) must be engine-free, so reimplement or port small helpers.

Response.startEventStream(): send(event,data,id)/comment/retry/isOpen/getLastEventId/awaitClosed(heartbeat)/close. Bounded queue via Builder.eventQueueEvents(64)/eventQueueBytes(64KiB) — NaruServe needs 256 KiB, set eventQueueBytes. maxEventStreams default 64 (#14).

RFC 6455 framing with allowedOrigins/subprotocols/maxMessageBytes/maxFramePayloadBytes/pingInterval; UpgradedConnection.onServerStop for 1001. WebSocket.sendText is synchronous (no per-connection send queue) — NaruServe must add the 1 MiB ordered send queue itself (#13/#15). maxUpgradedConnections default 16 (may need raising for T26 100-connection load).
TlsConfig.Builder keyStore/trustManagers/handshakeTimeout; Builder.tls()/listen(port,tls). Not in any sub-issue scope; expose later or keep (미확정).

NaruServe Middleware/Next chain is its own (#5). ForwardedHeadersFilter is a candidate for proxy-trust (#8 미확정). Host allowlist on by default (hostCheck=true, allowedHosts) — adapter must configure it or LAN clients get rejected.
NaruServe AccessLog is Core-side with redaction rules (#7); route TinyLog to NaruServe Logger in the adapter.

Engine Cookie uses fluent setters returning Cookie and String sameSite — not Kotlin-property friendly. NaruServe defines its own Cookie/SameSite in Core and serializes Set-Cookie itself (#10); engine Cookie.parse can parse request cookies in the adapter.
Not in NaruServe v1 scope; do not depend on tinyhttpd-session.

stop(graceMillis) + awaitTermination(millis) + isAlive(); shutdownGrace default 5000. UpgradedConnection.onServerStop / isServerStopping for long connections. Maps to app.shutdown(timeout, unit) (#6/#8/#15).

maxWorkers 64, maxConnections 128, maxConnectionsPerAddress 32, queueWaitTimeout 5000 (queue overflow -> 503 via ErrorResponses), workerStackBytes 256KiB. ServerStats for T26/T44 thread/connection assertions.
maxRequestLineBytes 8190 (-> 414), maxHeaderBytes 16 KiB and maxHeaderCount 100 (-> 431). Spec URL 8 KiB matches request line approx; resolves 431/414 미확정 in #8.
headerTimeout 10s, bodyReadTimeout 30s, idleTimeout 15s, idleTimeoutUnderLoad 2s, writeTimeout 30s, minRequestBodyRate default 0 (off) — #8 may enable it.
Rejects CL+TE, TE in HTTP/1.0, non-chunked final coding (400); chunk-size line and trailer limits. Already covered; #8 adds a T48 test only.
bindAddress(InetAddress) default null = ALL interfaces. NaruServe default must pass InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress() explicitly (#8).

dependency_strategy.recommended: Composite build: settings.gradle includeBuild('../TinyHttpd') with dependency 'com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core:0.1.0-SNAPSHOT' (+ tinyhttpd-websocket, optionally tinyhttpd-webserver) only from NaruServe-tinyhttpd; Gradle substitutes the included projects by group:name.
dependency_strategy.reason: TinyHttpd has no maven-publish plugin (not publishable today), same Gradle 8.14.3, same release=8 and API 21 animal-sniffer setup, zero runtime deps; group com.snoworca.tinyhttpd and project names tinyhttpd-* match coordinates for substitution. No TinyHttpd edits needed.
risks: Builds require the sibling checkout at ../TinyHttpd; CI and parallel git worktrees (kiwi lanes in other directories) break the relative path — use a gradle property/env (e.g. tinyhttpdDir) with ../TinyHttpd default.
SNAPSHOT/unpinned: TinyHttpd HEAD changes underneath NaruServe; record the TinyHttpd commit (currently 46b973e) in docs.
Release (#18) needs TinyHttpd published to Maven Central/local or shaded; composite build does not produce resolvable POM deps for consumers.
Included build root name 'tinyhttpd-project' plus included module :bench applies 'application' plugin — harmless but configures on every build.
TinyHttpd test fixtures (testFixtures(project(':tinyhttpd-core'))) via composite need explicit capability 'com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core-test-fixtures'.

Android sample (#17, AGP) consuming an includeBuild of plain java-library is fine, but the AGP project and TinyHttpd must share compatible Gradle; keep the Android app as a separate includeBuild/subproject excluded from default ./gradlew build if no SDK.
